description: This file defines a PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_Queue' that implements a simple array-backed queue using two stacks (input and output) based on Okasaki's persistent amortized queue. It includes methods for pushing, shifting, and checking if the queue is empty.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Queue
classes.description: Implements a queue data structure with push, shift, and isEmpty methods, backed by internal input and output stacks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the queue with an optional input array.

methods.name: shift
methods.description: Removes and returns the element at the front of the queue, reversing the input stack into the output stack if necessary.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds an element to the front of the queue.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if both input and output stacks are empty, indicating the queue is empty.
